mapper.select: select t.txn_id, t.order_id, t.merchant_id, t.out_trade_no, t.channel_trade_no, t.pay_channel, t.amount, t.status, t.paid_at, t.raw_notify, t.create_time, o.order_no from gas_pay_txn t left join gas_order o on t.order_id = o.order_id where t.out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

select txn_id, order_id, merchant_id, out_trade_no, channel_trade_no, pay_channel, amount, status, paid_at, raw_notify, create_time from gas_pay_txn where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'PAYING' order by txn_id desc limit 1 for update
select txn_id, order_id, merchant_id, out_trade_no, channel_trade_no, pay_channel, amount, status, paid_at, raw_notify, create_time from gas_pay_txn where order_id = #{orderId} order by txn_id
mapper.update: update gas_pay_txn set status = 'SUCCESS', channel_trade_no = #{channelTradeNo}, pay_channel = #{payChannel}, paid_at = sysdate(), raw_notify = #{rawNotify}, update_time = sysdate() where txn_id = #{txnId} and status != 'SUCCESS'
update gas_pay_txn set status = 'CLOSED', update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'PAYING'
